question: What additional types are included in the enumeration addressed to the lord of gods?
premises: The lord of gods is addressed.
One type named is the bearer of the triple staff.
Another type named is the seller of the Vedas.
inference: The enumeration further includes the triple-staff bearer and the Veda-seller.
plain_english: O Lord of gods, there is also the triple-staff bearer and likewise another, the seller of the Vedas.
